summary: No Blocker. The six contract parts hold at the audited head. The strict shape check rejects unknown keys at all four levels, wrong types, a repeated level and unit row, an upper-case band, a bad art name, a cast above its limits, and a name outside the roster. The roster kinds are child, animal, and adult. The shipped cast is {Nan, Pip, Sam} and {Teacher Kim, Nan, Sam}. The lit band is lower case, 'sprout', and equals meta.band.toLowerCase() of the seven shipped weeks. Art names are names only and match the D-A8 pattern. The 14 reader rows link one to one to the 14 cover rows of pictures.json, with no row missing or extra. The role copy holds the three labels of FR-10 and matches the rule of readers.ts. Three Nit findings, all latent with no shipped impact. The Green 1 captures agree with the plan claims.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] review-c: Part 1 and 4 (data check, latent). Location: dashboard/lib/storytime/print/cover-quest.ts:447-457. checkArtName hard-codes the 'l2-' level prefix and takes the unit but not the level. The expected name is always 'l2-u<n>-cover-quest-<side>-v1-300ppi.png', so a book row of a level other than 2 can never pass the art name check, whatever name its art holds. Phase 2 ships Level 2 Unit 1 only, and other levels are out of scope, so no shipped row is affected. Fix: pass the row level into checkArtName and build the prefix from it, or record the Level-2-only rule in the plan.

F2 [Nit] review-c: Part 2 (cast limits, latent). Location: dashboard/lib/storytime/print/cover-quest.ts:467-482. checkCastList enforces the upper limits only. The teacher front cast can hold no adult (Teacher Kim can be absent), the student front cast can hold an adult, and a repeated name counts twice but stays inside the limits. Spec FR-7.3 fixes the Level 2 Unit 1 cast, and T22 pins the limit cases only, so the shipped data passes and the pinned contract holds. Fix: add a presence rule for the teacher adult and a kind rule per front, or record the limits-only rule as the contract.

F3 [Nit] review-c: Part 6 (role copy, latent). Location: dashboard/lib/storytime/print/cover-quest.ts:1201-1206 and :1097. roleKeyOfLabel falls back to 'listen' on an unknown label, and roleMark falls back to the listen icons. A hand-built reader row with a mistyped roleLabel renders with the listen icons and no error. questReaders only makes labels from QUEST_ROLE_LABELS, so the shipped renders cannot reach the fallback. Fix: throw or return an error on an unknown label, or record the fallback as accepted.

Guard G-1: green1-p2-scope.txt lists only content/storytime/covers/quest.json and dashboard/lib/storytime/print/cover-quest.ts. The module imports only the shared D-A2 parts ./covers and ../../covers/back-text.

Part 1, the strict shape: checkQuestCoverData (cover-quest.ts:492-568) rejects an unknown key at the top, the row, the art, and the cast levels (TOP_KEYS, ROW_KEYS, ART_KEYS, CAST_KEYS at lines 285-288). It requires a non-empty series string, a roster object whose kinds are child, animal, or adult, and a non-empty books array. Each row needs integer level and unit values from 1 to 4, a unique level and unit pair, a litBand of the five lower-case bands, the three art names, and the two cast lists. It reads no file and writes no file. The T22 table holds 21 rejection rows, and each error names its field (test lines 1418-1536). The __proto__ case parses to an own key and is rejected as unknown (test lines 1499-1502).

Part 2, the roster and its limits: quest.json holds Nan child, Sam child, Pip animal, and Teacher Kim adult. The student front cast is [Nan, Pip, Sam], 2 children and 1 animal; the teacher front cast is [Teacher Kim, Nan, Sam], 1 adult and 2 children. checkCastList rejects more than 2 children on either front and more than 1 animal on the student front, and it rejects a name outside the roster. T23 pins the shipped cast and roster (test lines 1557-1561).

Part 3, the lit band mapping (P11): QUEST_BANDS is [seed, sprout, leaf, bud, flower] in the bar order (cover-quest.ts:47). The data check requires a lower-case band of this list (line 541). gameBar lights exactly one icon, the one equal to litBand (line 849). checkQuestLitBand proves exactly one data-lit="true" icon and the band of the book (lines 714-721). questReaders maps the capital schema band to lower case with meta.band.toLowerCase() (line 623). The shipped quest.json holds litBand 'sprout', and all seven shipped weeks hold meta.band 'Sprout', so the mapping holds. T23 cross-checks the seven weeks (test lines 1554-1556).

Part 4, the art name pattern and path safety: checkArtName (cover-quest.ts:447-457) requires the exact name 'l2-u1-cover-quest-<side>-v1-300ppi.png' per side and rejects a NUL byte, '..', '/', a backslash, an absolute path, a non-.png name, and a wrong side token. The shipped names match D-A8. The names are names only; the module resolves no art path at render time (assets.art comes from the caller), so the 'resolve under content/storytime/l2/print/pictures/ with no symlink follow' rule belongs to the build script of Task 2.7 (B08) and to Review B, not to this module. T23 proves the data check passes with no art folder present (test line 1569).

Part 5, the 14 reader rows and the pictures.json link (F8): a live read of content/storytime/l2/print/pictures.json gives 227 rows and 14 rows with use 'cover', two per week for weeks 1 to 7. Each row matches one book title of its week file; no row is missing or extra, and no (week, text) key repeats. All 28 named files exist on disk at 4000 x 3000 px, and every file name and line art name matches the l2-wNN-cover-<slug>-v1.png and -line-v1.png patterns. questReaders reads weeks 1 to 7, matches each book to its picture row by week and title, and throws when a row is absent (cover-quest.ts:609-632). The test pins the count 14 before any filter, the pictures.json cover count 14 (so an extra cover row fails), the per-row file names, and the slug uniqueness (test lines 1208-1256). The sha256 of the seven week files and pictures.json is unchanged by the call (T15).

Part 6, the role copy (F7, T16): QUEST_ROLE_LABELS holds 'Listen and read.', 'Sound it out.', and 'Say the first sound.' (cover-quest.ts:56-60), which match the rule of readers.ts roleOf (lines 216-221). The shipped rows give 8 listen readers, the 7 read-alongs and 'Nan Can Nod', and 6 sound readers; no reader uses the first sound label. T16 proves the label, the title, and the week text equal the shared cover page of compileStorytimeReaders for all 14 readers (test lines 1265-1290), so the copied rule cannot drift unseen.

Spec clarifications of test-strategy section 5 that the code shows: item 12, the role set includes 'Sound it out.' for 6 readers (labels at lines 56-60, counts pinned by T15); the picture rows come from pictures.json, not the week file (readCoverPictures and the link at lines 598-616); the lit band is lower case in quest.json and capital in the week schema (lines 541 and 623). Pin P12, the 120000 ms timeouts, hold in the test file: nine tests carry an explicit timeout of 120000 ms.

Green 1 captures agree with the plan claims (A5 check): green1-p2.txt gives 1 file and 185 tests passed. green1-p2-project.txt gives 62 files and 1488 tests passed, exit 0, 1265 s, which equals the plan equation (61 baseline files plus the Red file; 1269 plus 34 plus 185 tests). green1-p2-lint.txt gives 0 errors and 1 warning (an unused variable in the test file, line 1695). green1-p2-checks.txt ends with 0 failed checks and exit 0. green1-p2-checkweeks.txt records 305 PASS, 9 WARN, 0 FAIL, with the 7 family-pictures rows changed by the named week-package commits and no other row. mutants-green1.txt ends with mutants: 33, caught: 33, survivors empty, and restore cmp: all equal.
